nodes.label: Purview Retention Policies
nodes.rationale: Microsoft returns the individual per-workload location lists on a retention policy empty, with the real scope carried in Workload instead, so templates are rebuilt from Workload rather than the location fields to stay deployable

nodes.label: Preservation Lock
nodes.rationale: irreversible retention lock: once set on a policy, nobody, including a Global Administrator, can disable or delete it, remove locations from it, or shorten its retention period; locations can still be added and retention extended, but nothing already set can be taken back. Microsoft omits this setting from the Purview portal UI entirely to guard against it being applied by accident, but CIPP exposes it through the deploy drawer and via templates without a confirmation step
